raw:
The user wants UI strings for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese app.

- s1: feedback form submit button. Taiwan convention: 「送出意見」or「送出」. The instructions say 提交→送出. So s1 should be something like「送出意見」.
- s2: settings page button to write/save changes. 保存→儲存, 設置→設定. So something like「儲存變更」or「儲存設定」. The description: 設定頁改完後有一個按鈕把變更寫入 — a button that writes/saves changes. Common Taiwan UI: 「儲存變更」.
- s3: status text after changes are written. Something like「變更已儲存」or「設定已儲存」. Status text: 「變更已儲存」.

Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.

Maybe s1: 「送出意見」 since it's a feedback form (意見表單). Could also be 「送出」but adding context is better: 「送出意見」.

s2: 「儲存變更」.

s3: 「變更已儲存」or「已儲存變更」. Taiwan style often「變更已儲存」. I'll pick「變更已儲存」.

Output JSON only.</think>{"s1": "送出意見", "s2": "儲存變更", "s3": "變更已儲存"}
